metadata.generation_note: V3 dual-pool search experience bank separating initial question-level planning strategies (task_experiences) from mid-search observation-conditioned strategies (step_experiences), with natural-language retrieval_obs descriptions.

task_experiences.title: Target the core entity and sought relation in the initial search
task_experiences.principle: Search the exact entity name together with the single fact or relation being asked for. Avoid answering from uncertain memory or searching the full conversational wording of the question. The first result set targets the answer-bearing fact.
task_experiences.when_to_apply: When no external evidence has been retrieved yet and the answer is not certain from the question.
task_experiences.retrieval_obs: A question asking for a specific fact or relation about a named entity where external evidence needs to be retrieved first.
task_experiences.trigger: no external evidence has been retrieved and the answer is not certain
task_experiences.recommended_action: search the exact entity name together with the single fact or relation being asked for
task_experiences.avoid_action: answer from uncertain memory or search the full conversational wording of the question
task_experiences.expected_effect: the first result set targets the answer-bearing fact

task_experiences.title: Direct one-hop factoid lookup
task_experiences.principle: Search the entity plus the requested attribute in a short query, then answer as soon as a snippet states the value. Avoid decomposing a one-hop fact into unnecessary searches or returning a broad biography. Direct factoid questions finish within one or two steps.
task_experiences.when_to_apply: When the question asks one direct who, what, when, or where fact about a single named entity.
task_experiences.retrieval_obs: Who, what, when, or where question asking for a single direct fact or attribute about one named entity, person, work, or event.
task_experiences.trigger: the question asks one who, what, when, or where fact about a named entity
task_experiences.recommended_action: search the entity plus the requested attribute in a short query, then answer as soon as a snippet states the value
task_experiences.avoid_action: decompose a one-hop fact into unnecessary searches or return a broad biography
task_experiences.expected_effect: direct factoid questions finish within one or two steps

task_experiences.title: Exact-phrase search for quotations, lyrics, or titles
task_experiences.principle: Search the distinctive phrase in quotation marks with one context word such as author, song, film, or episode. Avoid searching only generic surrounding terms that discard the unique phrase. Exact-match results identify the source efficiently.
task_experiences.when_to_apply: When the question contains a distinctive quotation, title, lyric fragment, episode name, or unusual phrase.
task_experiences.retrieval_obs: Question containing a distinctive quotation, song lyric, book or episode title, or specific named phrase whose source, author, or performer must be identified.
task_experiences.trigger: the question contains a distinctive quotation, title, lyric fragment, episode name, or unusual phrase
task_experiences.recommended_action: search the distinctive phrase in quotation marks with one context word such as author, song, film, or episode
task_experiences.avoid_action: search only generic surrounding terms that discard the unique phrase
task_experiences.expected_effect: exact-match results identify the source efficiently

task_experiences.title: Canonical entity attribute lookup
task_experiences.principle: Search the canonical entity name plus the exact attribute label and check that the snippet predicates the value of that entity. Avoid returning an attribute of a related person, organization, or work. The entity-attribute pair is retrieved without relation confusion.
task_experiences.when_to_apply: When the question asks for an occupation, nationality, birthplace, genre, language, or similar attribute of an entity.
task_experiences.retrieval_obs: Question asking for the occupation, profession, nationality, citizenship, birthplace, genre, or language of a named person, work, or organization.
task_experiences.trigger: the question asks for an occupation, nationality, birthplace, genre, language, or similar attribute of an entity
task_experiences.recommended_action: search the canonical entity name plus the exact attribute label and check that the snippet predicates the value of that entity
task_experiences.avoid_action: return an attribute of a related person, organization, or work
task_experiences.expected_effect: the entity-attribute pair is retrieved without relation confusion

task_experiences.title: Decompose multi-hop bridge questions step by step
task_experiences.principle: Solve the first relation, record the exact intermediate entity, then issue a second query for that entity and the final relation. Avoid combining all hops into one overloaded query or skipping the intermediate identity. Each search has one resolvable relation and the evidence chain stays traceable.
task_experiences.when_to_apply: When the question requires identifying an intermediate bridge entity before the requested final fact can be searched.
task_experiences.retrieval_obs: Multi-hop question where an unstated intermediate person, work, organization, or place must be identified first before looking up its requested attribute or relation.
task_experiences.trigger: the question requires identifying an intermediate entity before the requested final fact can be searched
task_experiences.recommended_action: solve the first relation, record the exact intermediate entity, then issue a second query for that entity and the final relation
task_experiences.avoid_action: combine all hops into one overloaded query or skip the intermediate identity
task_experiences.expected_effect: each search has one resolvable relation and the evidence chain stays traceable

task_experiences.title: Retrieve symmetric attributes separately for entity comparisons
task_experiences.principle: Retrieve the same comparison attribute for each entity separately, normalize units or dates, then apply the requested comparison. Avoid comparing different attributes or deciding after finding a value for only one entity. The comparison is based on symmetric evidence.
task_experiences.when_to_apply: When the question compares two entities by date, age, count, size, location, or whether they share a common attribute.
task_experiences.retrieval_obs: Comparison question asking which of two people, works, places, or events is older, earlier, larger, or whether both share the same nationality, occupation, or attribute.
task_experiences.trigger: the question compares two entities by date, age, count, size, location, or another attribute
task_experiences.recommended_action: retrieve the same comparison attribute for each entity separately, normalize units or dates, then apply the requested comparison
task_experiences.avoid_action: compare different attributes or decide after finding a value for only one entity
task_experiences.expected_effect: the comparison is based on symmetric evidence

task_experiences.title: Include temporal qualifiers for time-sensitive questions
task_experiences.principle: Include the relevant year or temporal qualifier in the query and distinguish event date from publication or announcement date. Avoid using an undated snippet or confusing a planned date with an occurred event. The answer respects the question's temporal scope.
task_experiences.when_to_apply: When the question uses current, latest, first, before, after, release date, or another time-sensitive qualifier.
task_experiences.retrieval_obs: Time-sensitive question asking when an event happened, a release date, or which entity came first, before, after, or during a specific year or period.
task_experiences.trigger: the question uses current, latest, first, before, after, release date, or another time-sensitive qualifier
task_experiences.recommended_action: include the relevant year or temporal qualifier in the query and distinguish event date from publication or announcement date
task_experiences.avoid_action: use an undated snippet or confuse a planned date with an occurred event
task_experiences.expected_effect: the answer respects the question's temporal scope

task_experiences.title: Search the rarer condition first for two-condition intersection questions
task_experiences.principle: Retrieve candidates for the rarer condition first, then test those candidates against the second condition. Avoid searching both broad conditions independently and guessing an overlap. The intersection is established with entity-specific evidence.
task_experiences.when_to_apply: When the question asks which entity satisfies two separate conditions or belongs to both sets.
task_experiences.retrieval_obs: Question asking which person, work, or entity satisfies two distinct conditions or belongs to two different groups or categories.
task_experiences.trigger: the question asks which entity satisfies two separate conditions or belongs to both sets
task_experiences.recommended_action: retrieve candidates for the rarer condition first, then test those candidates against the second condition
task_experiences.avoid_action: search both broad conditions independently and guess an overlap
task_experiences.expected_effect: the intersection is established with entity-specific evidence

task_experiences.title: Verify the exact creator or performer role for a named work
task_experiences.principle: Search the exact work title plus the requested creator role and verify the role wording in the snippet. Avoid returning a cast member, character, editor, or similarly related person with the wrong role. The answer matches the requested relationship to the work.
task_experiences.when_to_apply: When the question asks who created, wrote, directed, performed, or published a named work.
task_experiences.retrieval_obs: Question asking who wrote, directed, composed, performed, produced, or published a specific named book, film, song, album, or series.
task_experiences.trigger: the question asks who created, wrote, directed, performed, or published a named work
task_experiences.recommended_action: search the exact work title plus the requested creator role and verify the role wording in the snippet
task_experiences.avoid_action: return a cast member, character, editor, or similarly related person with the wrong role
task_experiences.expected_effect: the answer matches the requested relationship to the work

task_experiences.title: Resolve immediate institution or venue before broader geographic location
task_experiences.principle: Resolve the immediate place or institution first, then search that exact entity for the requested broader location. Avoid jumping directly from the starting entity to a guessed country or city. Geographic hops preserve the requested level of granularity.
task_experiences.when_to_apply: When the question links a person or work to a city, region, country, venue, or institution through multiple relations.
task_experiences.retrieval_obs: Multi-hop location question asking for the city, county, state, or country where an entity's university, headquarters, birthplace, or venue is located.
task_experiences.trigger: the question links a person or work to a city, region, country, venue, or institution through multiple relations
task_experiences.recommended_action: resolve the immediate place or institution first, then search that exact entity for the requested broader location
task_experiences.avoid_action: jump directly from the starting entity to a guessed country or city
task_experiences.expected_effect: geographic hops preserve the requested level of granularity

step_experiences.title: Stop searching and answer immediately when snippets explicitly support the answer
step_experiences.principle: Extract the minimal answer string supported by the snippet and return it in the <answer> tag immediately. Avoid spending another search on the same fact or adding unsupported qualifications. The episode terminates promptly with an evidence-backed answer.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When the latest search results explicitly state a complete answer to the question.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: Current observation snippets already contain a clear, direct statement answering the question's entity and requested relation.
step_experiences.trigger: the latest search results explicitly state a complete answer to the question
step_experiences.recommended_action: extract the minimal answer string supported by the snippet and return it in the answer tag
step_experiences.avoid_action: spend another search on the same fact or add unsupported qualifications
step_experiences.expected_effect: the episode terminates promptly with an evidence-backed answer

step_experiences.title: Refine query with discriminating qualifiers after irrelevant or duplicate results
step_experiences.principle: Change the query by adding a discriminating qualifier, alternate entity name, date, title, or relation phrase. Avoid repeating the identical query or merely reordering generic words. The next retrieval explores a meaningfully different evidence path.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When the latest search results are irrelevant, ambiguous, empty, or repeat information already seen.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: Current observation returned irrelevant passages, ambiguous namesakes, no matching results, or repeated snippets that do not answer the question.
step_experiences.trigger: the latest results are irrelevant, ambiguous, or repeat information already seen
step_experiences.recommended_action: change the query by adding a discriminating qualifier, alternate entity name, date, title, or relation phrase
step_experiences.avoid_action: repeat the identical query or merely reorder generic words
step_experiences.expected_effect: the next retrieval explores a meaningfully different evidence path

step_experiences.title: Follow up on partial leads with a targeted search for the missing relation
step_experiences.principle: Treat a topically relevant snippet as a lead, identify the missing fact, and search that fact directly before answering. Avoid inferring the answer from topical proximity or from an entity merely appearing in the snippet. The final answer is grounded in an explicit relation rather than a guess.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When a retrieved snippet is topically relevant and mentions related entities but does not explicitly state the needed relation or value.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: Current observation mentions the target topic or related entities, but the specific requested attribute, relation, or value is missing from the snippet.
step_experiences.trigger: a snippet is topically relevant but does not explicitly support the needed relation or value
step_experiences.recommended_action: treat it as a lead, identify the missing fact, and search that fact directly before answering
step_experiences.avoid_action: infer the answer from topical proximity or from an entity merely appearing in the snippet
step_experiences.expected_effect: the final answer is grounded in an explicit relation rather than a guess

step_experiences.title: Disambiguate similarly named entities using occupation, date, or work title
step_experiences.principle: Bind each retrieved fact to the full entity identity and use occupation, location, date, or work title to disambiguate. Avoid merging facts belonging to namesakes or assuming every occurrence of a surname is the same entity. Entity resolution remains consistent across search steps.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When the retrieved search results contain multiple people, works, or places with identical or similar names.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: Current observation contains multiple people, films, songs, or places with the same or similar names that have different dates, roles, or locations.
step_experiences.trigger: the question or evidence contains multiple people, works, places, or similarly named entities
step_experiences.recommended_action: bind each retrieved fact to the full entity identity and use occupation, location, date, or work title to disambiguate
step_experiences.avoid_action: merge facts belonging to namesakes or assume every occurrence of a surname is the same entity
step_experiences.expected_effect: entity resolution remains consistent across search steps

step_experiences.title: Carry forward the resolved intermediate entity to search the second hop
step_experiences.principle: Carry forward only the resolved intermediate entity or value and search it with the remaining predicate. Avoid repeating the first-hop query or answering with the intermediate entity when the question asks for a later fact. The next step advances the chain instead of restarting it.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When the latest search results resolve the first hop (intermediate entity) but the final requested attribute remains unknown.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: After the first search, the current observation identifies the intermediate bridge entity, but the final requested attribute about that entity has not been retrieved yet.
step_experiences.trigger: the latest results resolve one hop but the final requested attribute remains unknown
step_experiences.recommended_action: carry forward only the resolved entity/value and search it with the remaining predicate
step_experiences.avoid_action: repeat the first-hop query or answer with the intermediate entity when the question asks for a later fact
step_experiences.expected_effect: the next step advances the chain instead of restarting it

step_experiences.title: Verify bridge identity across hops and output only the final endpoint
step_experiences.principle: Verify the shared bridge entity is identical across both snippets, then return only the final endpoint value. Avoid including the intermediate bridge entity as the answer or joining facts from different namesakes. The composed answer follows the supported two-hop chain.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When retrieved facts across turns form a complete chain from the question entity to the requested final answer.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: Previous search history and current observation together resolve both the intermediate entity and the final answer value across the multi-hop chain.
step_experiences.trigger: two retrieved facts form a complete chain from the question entity to the requested answer
step_experiences.recommended_action: verify the shared bridge entity is identical across both snippets, then return only the final endpoint value
step_experiences.avoid_action: include the bridge as the answer or join facts from different namesakes
step_experiences.expected_effect: the composed answer follows the supported two-hop chain

step_experiences.title: Search only the missing second entity once the first comparison side is known
step_experiences.principle: Retain the first entity's value from the observation and search only the second entity with the identical attribute. Avoid searching the first entity again or inferring the second value from relative wording. The remaining search fills the exact evidence gap.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When evidence for one side of a two-entity comparison has been found in the snippets but the other side is still missing.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: In a comparison question between two entities, the current observation gives the date, number, or attribute for the first entity, while the second entity's value is still missing.
step_experiences.trigger: evidence for one side of a comparison has been found but the other side is missing
step_experiences.recommended_action: retain the first value and search only the second entity with the identical attribute
step_experiences.avoid_action: search the first entity again or infer the second value from relative wording
step_experiences.expected_effect: the remaining search fills the exact evidence gap

step_experiences.title: Extract exact quantitative values with matching unit and year
step_experiences.principle: Extract the exact number with its unit and time reference from the snippet, converting units only when the question requires it. Avoid dropping the unit, mixing values from different years, or rounding away a distinction needed by the question. The numerical answer is precise and contextually correct.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When the retrieved snippets contain numbers, dates, durations, ranks, or populations for a quantitative question.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: Current observation contains numbers, dates, populations, lengths, or statistics with specific units and years that must be matched to the question.
step_experiences.trigger: the answer requires a number, date, duration, rank, population, or other quantitative value
step_experiences.recommended_action: extract the exact number with its unit and time reference, converting units only when the question requires it
step_experiences.avoid_action: drop the unit, mix values from different years, or round away a distinction needed by the question
step_experiences.expected_effect: the numerical answer is precise and contextually correct

step_experiences.title: Resolve conflicting dates or facts across snippets with a targeted query
step_experiences.principle: Issue a disambiguating query with the full entity and disputed attribute, preferring a snippet that directly states the relation in the correct context. Avoid averaging conflicting numbers or selecting the first result without resolving context. The conflict is resolved before finalizing the answer.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When retrieved snippets disagree on a critical name, date, role, or number.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: Current observation snippets give conflicting dates, numbers, or names for the target entity and relation.
step_experiences.trigger: retrieved snippets disagree on a critical name, date, or number
step_experiences.recommended_action: issue a disambiguating query with the full entity and disputed attribute, preferring a snippet that directly states the relation in the correct context
step_experiences.avoid_action: average conflicting numbers or select the first result without resolving context
step_experiences.expected_effect: the conflict is resolved before finalizing the answer

step_experiences.title: Synthesize accumulated evidence and answer instead of over-searching
step_experiences.principle: Synthesize the existing snippets across the search history against the exact question and output <answer> if every required relation is supported. Avoid continuing to search merely to accumulate more text or overwriting a supported fact with noisier results. The agent avoids wasting the search budget.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When the search history and current observation already contain enough evidence to answer the question.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: Multiple search steps have already been completed and the accumulated observations contain all facts needed to answer the question directly.
step_experiences.trigger: the search history already contains enough evidence but the model is considering another broad query
step_experiences.recommended_action: synthesize the existing snippets against the exact question and answer if every required relation is supported
step_experiences.avoid_action: continue searching merely to accumulate more text or overwrite a supported fact with noisier results
step_experiences.expected_effect: the agent avoids wasting the four-step search budget

step_experiences.title: Simplify overloaded multi-clause queries when search results are weak
step_experiences.principle: Reduce the next search to one entity-relation pair, starting with the dependency needed by later hops. Avoid adding more clauses or copying the entire multi-hop question again. Retrieval returns focused evidence that can seed the next hop.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When the previous search query contained many clauses and the returned results failed to address any clause directly.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: Previous search query was long or combined multiple clauses, and the current observation returned weak or unfocused passages that missed the core entity.
step_experiences.trigger: the current query contains many clauses and the results fail to address any clause directly
step_experiences.recommended_action: reduce the next search to one entity-relation pair, starting with the dependency needed by later hops
step_experiences.avoid_action: add more clauses or copy the entire multi-hop question again
step_experiences.expected_effect: retrieval returns focused evidence that can seed the next hop

step_experiences.title: Return the concise canonical name or value expected by the question
step_experiences.principle: Return the shortest unambiguous form that preserves the identity expected by the question. Avoid including a sentence of explanation or switching to an unsupported alias. The final answer is concise while remaining semantically equivalent to the evidence.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When the retrieved evidence supports the answer but uses a longer official name, alias, abbreviation, or alternate spelling.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: Current observation confirms the answer entity or value, and the agent is ready to format the final concise canonical answer string.
step_experiences.trigger: the evidence supports the answer but uses a longer official name, alias, abbreviation, or alternate spelling
step_experiences.recommended_action: return the shortest unambiguous form that preserves the identity expected by the question
step_experiences.avoid_action: include a sentence of explanation or switch to an unsupported alias
step_experiences.expected_effect: the final answer is concise while remaining semantically equivalent to the evidence

step_experiences.title: Answer from best supported evidence or run one targeted query on the final step
step_experiences.principle: Use the strongest supported answer from the accumulated evidence if one exists; otherwise make one final highly specific entity-relation search rather than a broad retry. Avoid repeating a failed query or outputting an answer contradicted by the snippets. The final step is allocated to either a defensible answer or the most targeted remaining evidence gap.
step_experiences.when_to_apply: When only one action step remains or repeated searches have not produced direct evidence.
step_experiences.retrieval_obs: Step 3 or 4 of 4 in the search budget after previous searches returned only partial evidence or failed to find the direct answer.
step_experiences.trigger: only one action step remains or repeated searches have not produced direct evidence
step_experiences.recommended_action: use the strongest supported answer from the accumulated evidence if one exists; otherwise make one final highly specific entity-relation search rather than a broad retry
step_experiences.avoid_action: repeat a failed query or output an answer contradicted by the snippets
step_experiences.expected_effect: the final step is allocated to either a defensible answer or the most targeted remaining evidence gap
